game_concept: A action defense set in The Kingdom – Orchard Lane, the royal orchard lane: the knight must handle thieves while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Counter Tower: Increase a counter variable every time scrolls reach the royal seal, stacking the tower higher.
theme: The Kingdom – Orchard Lane: the royal orchard lane
core_gameplay_loop: In Orchard Lane, repeat each round: Increase a counter variable every time scrolls reach the royal seal, stacking the tower higher. Each round, thieves strike the royal seal, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the delivered value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the royal seal from thieves in Orchard Lane: keep the delivered meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 50-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: delivered drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 50-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 3 (intro tier): Counter Tower
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Counter Tower' (Week 1 slot 3), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Orchard Lane'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how delivered changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against thieves in Orchard Lane.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 50 seconds while delivered > 0.
